Source [S2] corroborates this: 'Rockwell and Owen’s (1987) pseudonorm blend returns the p-norm distance to the blended union of implicit surfaces of signed distance functions.' Both sources confirm the terminology (pseudonorm/superelliptic), the locality, the surface type (implicit/SDF), and the mathematical operation (p-norm distance to blended union).
